name: Fort Garry Hotel
scope: Standing Fort Garry Hotel at 222 Broadway, Winnipeg, including its 1913 Château-style principal hotel, formal entrance canopy, copper roof, rear dining-room arc and attached low reception volumes.
era: Standing historic hotel with its modern entrance apron and rear service sections.

originalReview.notes: The historic street view shows the distinctive chateau roof, long ranks of dormers, large arched windows, continuous oriel bays and the exterior stone lobby canopy.

review.method: Exact Qualla archival postcard, named current map, primary heritage dimensions.
review.notes: The exact 1913 postcard was already published on Qualla and is the archived public-domain view used for architectural form. Modern dimensions and roof profiles use the native mapped plan and lidar.
